summary: Pin inline-exec output-cap overrun: rejects and kills the child, never truncates silently

per.section: An unresolved inline-exec span fails the tick

tests: a command whose stdout exceeds the inline-exec output cap (src/Prompt.ts INLINE_EXEC_MAX_BUFFER) rejects rather than resolving with truncated output
acceptance: new test fails against a runInlineExec that silently truncates past the cap instead of rejecting; passes on current tree
notes: Sweep of tests/Prompt.test.ts (posture-sweep.md): cap-overrun is one of four named resolution-failure triggers in spec but has zero coverage anywhere in the repo — a regression to silent truncation would ship green.
